blocks.text: PRD: Lakeshore store pickup across four stores

This is the working cut for LSH-PRD-2023-026 on May 4, 2023. Luis Ortega asked for a written bound after the current path (Woo pickup plugin, one store, three stores ignored) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host pickup.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on transfer-as-pickup in v1, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Customer selects store before add-to-cart. Qty is that store. Cutoff 15:30 local. No transfer as pickup. I am not restating a hallway yes. transfer-as-pickup in v1 is out because Transfers are a truck, not a click. Cole will not promise a 16:00 pickup that is still on US-20. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at stores=4, cutoff=15:30, saw=1, miles=18.6, weeks=7, plugin=1, miss=3, local=1. Sibling tickets LSH-4718 and LSH-SYS-2022-031. I will not reopen transfer-as-pickup in v1 in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: inv-api.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (30): refuse on transfer-as-pickup in v1, lock is store picker, per-store qty, 15:30 cutoff, no transfer. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4718.
Pickup at Michigan City must not pull Elkhart. I will not drive a circular saw across the county because the site lied.

What a skeptical user would try first on pickup.lakeshore.internal: the path Luis Ortega actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on woo-prod.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

What I will not claim in LSH-PRD-2023-026

I will not claim transfer-as-pickup in v1 is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host pickup.lakeshore.internal.
First useful slice for LSH-4718

First useful is store picker, per-store qty, 15:30 cutoff, no transfer, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Luis Ortega sees that slice on pickup.lakeshore.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Luis Ortega is in the thread. I will not hide it inside LSH-PRD-2023-026.
